basic_profile.bio: A dedicated gamer from Chicago who loves exploring virtual worlds and engaging in co-op missions. I’m 27, work as a software developer, and game in the evenings after work, typically between 7 PM and midnight CST. Single and always on the lookout for fellow gamers to team up with. I have a penchant for post-apocalyptic and open-world games, which is why State of Decay 2 is a favorite. Not a fan of toxic communities, so I steer clear of drama online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in computer science and several years of experience in software development, I have a strong grasp of technology and gaming systems. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and self-taught programming skills, honed by countless hours of gaming and modding.
